title: Blockchain/Web3 Developer
description: Learn blockchain fundamentals, Solidity smart contracts, Ethereum tooling, dapp frontends, testing, and security basics.

tree.name: Blockchain Foundations
tree.description: Understand blocks, transactions, wallets, keys, gas, consensus, nodes, and what should not go on-chain.

children.name: Wallets and Transactions
children.description: Learn accounts, private keys, addresses, signatures, gas fees, and transaction lifecycle.

children.name: Ethereum Stack
children.description: Map clients, RPC, EVM, smart contracts, events, tokens, bridges, and scaling options.

tree.name: Solidity Smart Contracts
tree.description: Write, compile, test, and deploy contracts with clear rules and predictable state changes.

resources.title: Solidity, Blockchain, and Smart Contract Course (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Contract Anatomy
children.description: Use state variables, functions, modifiers, events, errors, mappings, inheritance, and interfaces.

children.name: Token Standards
children.description: Understand ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, approvals, transfers, metadata, and common pitfalls.

children.name: Practice: Smart Contract Threat Review
children.description: Review access control, reentrancy, upgradeability, events, tests, and gas assumptions before deployment.

tree.name: Tooling, Testing, and Dapps
tree.description: Use professional tools to test contracts, deploy safely, and connect them to frontend apps.

resources.title: Full Stack Web3 Development with JavaScript (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Contract Testing
children.description: Write unit, integration, fuzz, fork, and gas tests before deployment.

children.name: Dapp Frontend
children.description: Connect wallets, read contract state, send transactions, handle pending states, and index events.

tree.name: Security and Portfolio
tree.description: Learn common vulnerabilities, audits, upgrades, testnets, and responsible deployment habits.

children.name: Common Vulnerabilities
children.description: Study reentrancy, access control, integer assumptions, oracle risk, MEV, and upgrade risks.

children.name: Gas, Upgrades, and Governance
children.description: Understand gas optimization, proxy upgrade risks, multisigs, timelocks, governance, and deployment ceremonies.

children.name: Project: Audited Testnet Dapp
children.description: Build and test a dapp, deploy to a testnet, document architecture, and include a security checklist.
